headline: Earnings per share jump, but figure looks unreliable
summary_short: EPS on file was IDR 1,571 versus IDR 90 last quarter and IDR 921 a year ago, but the figure may not be a single-quarter number.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. The jump from IDR 90 to IDR 1,571 is implausible for one quarter and may reflect a cumulative or mis-scaled value. A web search did not surface Q3 2026 results; earlier 2026 coverage described sharply lower profit. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. EPS (Yahoo earningsChart) looks inconsistent with the prior quarter and the y/y and q/q deltas should not be relied on.
